design: Post-hoc methodological rebuild; not preregistered or independent replication
scope: Population genetic liability, not risk of complications within IBD patients
outcome_release: FinnGen R12, retained for a single uniform release; not claimed latest
effect_allele: Allele2; beta unchanged from original GRCh37 source
base_qc: finite beta and positive finite SE
valid and consistent cohort p fields
unique exact allele-position LD reference match
primary_cohort_p_rule: meta-analysis P strictly below minimum component-cohort P, with non-overlapping displayed-precision intervals
sensitivity_cohort_p_rule: Retain rows failing only the meta-versus-component P rule or its rounding ambiguity; all other QC unchanged
source_qc_limitation: Original files predate some publication filtering; absent INFO/MAF prevents complete reproduction of the publication QC. Do not claim complete post-publication-QC identity.
ld_reference: Previously audited public legacy 1000 Genomes EUR MAF>0.01, 502 individuals; not FinnGen in-sample LD
harmonisation: Unique reciprocal GRCh37-to-GRCh38 SNV lift; complement on reversed mapping; exact outcome allele pair; no ambiguous duplicate or coordinate-only match
primary_mr: Multiplicative random-effects IVW for >=2 valid SNPs; normal CI with residual inflation capped below at 1; Wald ratio only for one SNP, explicitly weaker evidence
mr_presso: Secondary; fixed seeds 271828 and 314159, 100000 simulations if feasible; retain bounded p values and all runs; failure is not absence of pleiotropy
fdr: BH across the 12 primary IVW/Wald hypotheses; unestimable tests count as p=1 in family, but are reported unestimable, not null effects
steiger: Not runnable from original sources without reliable exposure frequency and binary-liability inputs/prevalence; no default continuous-trait approximation and no reference MAF presented as measured exposure frequency
coloc_selection: Merge overlapping GRCh37 +/-500kb windows around all primary exposure clumped index SNPs, across all 3 exposures; evaluate all exposure/outcome pairs in each merged region where full dense data pass QC, not only significant outcome regions
coloc_data: All eligible regional variants irrespective of P, allele/build matched, beta and SE squared, case-control type; no invented sample frequencies; full mapping and coverage diagnostics required
coloc_reporting: Report H0-H4 jointly, regional signal strength and SNP coverage; default H4>=0.8 is descriptive strong support, not confirmation; prior robustness requires H4>=0.8 at p12=1e-6, not highest rank alone; H4 low does not prove distinct causality if either trait is weak
coloc_single_signal_limit: ABF assumes at most one causal variant per trait per region; multi-signal is deferred without suitable LD, not claimed completed
sample_overlap: Exact overlap unresolved; never claim absent or quantitatively corrected
subtype_comparison: No differential-effect claim from significant versus nonsignificant; covariance-aware contrast required for formal subtype difference
